text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan delivered solid results in a 
GⅡ race mixed with veteran Senior Year 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by her friends' cheers, her 
hype reaches MAX! She declares her entry 
into the Arima Kinen right out on the 
turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her hard work, the hoof she 
worried about made a full recovery. Tosen 
Jordan mumbled her gratitude to the 
Trainer who had supported her all this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Arima Kinen is a GⅠ packed 
with fierce competitors. Putting aside her 
Trainer's worries, she nonchalantly says, 
"All I can do is try my best, right?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Was this sheer folly born of ignorance, or 
reckless bravado? The Arima Kinen was just 
one month away.
